name: WALL STREET POKER
description: Wall Street Poker is a Seven-Card Stud variant with buyable community cards. 2-7 players. 52-card deck. Deal 3 hole cards (2 down, 1 up). 4 community cards ('Wall Street') placed face-up with escalating costs (1-4 units). Players can buy a community card (goes to pot) or get a free card from deck. Named after aggressive financial bidding.

content.text: Wall Street Poker is a Seven-Card Stud variant with buyable community cards. 2-7 players. 52-card deck. Deal 3 hole cards (2 down, 1 up). 4 community cards ('Wall Street') placed face-up with escalating costs (1-4 units). Players can buy a community card (goes to pot) or get a free card from deck. Named after aggressive financial bidding.

Wall Street is a seven-card stud variant in the buy-your-card family where players pay fixed amounts to the pot to acquire cards. The name refers to the row of four face-up community cards (Wall Street) that players may buy at 1-4 units or pass for a free card from the deck. It shares mechanics with The Price is Right but offers four market cards and a free-card alternative; the theme evokes bidding and speculation in home poker.
Standard 52-card deck; one pack. No jokers or stripped cards.
Ante. 3 hole cards (2 down, 1 up) + 4 community 'Wall Street' cards.
